signals.summary: A hybrid rule‐based and constrained large language model (LLM) system that drafts EDX reports from structured EDX measurements is evaluated.

signals.summary: In this dataset and classification task, the task-specific neural network demonstrated higher diagnostic performance than the evaluated large language model, but the findings should be interpreted in light of the fundamentally different training paradigms and intended applications of these AI systems.

signals.title: Large Language Model Authorship in Ophthalmic Publications.
signals.summary: It is shown that LLM-generated text is increasingly present in the ophthalmic literature and is rarely disclosed, and there is a significant risk that undisclosed LLM usage will continue to increase and may jeopardize authorship integrity and long-term reliability of published findings.

signals.title: Hierarchical Multi-agent Large Language Model Reasoning for Autonomous Heterogeneous Catalyst Discovery
signals.summary: It is demonstrated that hierarchical agentic large language model reasoning can efficiently drive simulation and scientific exploration, and multi-agent collaboration accelerates heterogeneous catalyst discovery and marks a step toward more autonomous, reasoning-guided scientific exploration.

signals.title: Model Construction and Application Examples for Educational Resource Recommendations Combining Large Models and Knowledge Graphs——Using the Textbook “Introduction to Artificial Intelligence” as an Example
signals.summary: Research indicates that this collaborative framework effectively improves the accuracy, coherence, and interpretability of recommendations, providing a viable solution for textbook-level teaching resource organization and the optimization of personalized learning paths.

signals.title: On-device large language models: a survey of model compression and system optimization
signals.summary: A clear taxonomy of quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, low rank adaptation, and hybrid pipelines is presented, explaining where representative methods belong and how they compose, and a practical bridge from algorithmic compression to resource aligned and reliable on device and edge deployment is proposed.

signals.title: Large language model assisted hyper-heuristic evolutionary algorithm for groundwater level prediction
signals.summary: Experiments demonstrate that LLMHHEA exhibits stable convergence performance and achieves better predictive results compared to traditional metaheuristic-ANN combination methods, and provides a new intelligent paradigm for complex optimization and prediction problems and offers robust technical support for sustainable water resource management.

signals.title: Can Artificial Intelligence Support Patient Education in Scabies? A Comparative Analysis of Large Language Model Responses
signals.summary: AI chatbots provide generally informative but variable-quality responses to scabies-related questions, and should be considered supportive resources rather than substitutes for professional medical advice.

signals.title: Performing Best When Needed Least: Reader Experience Shapes Accuracy Gains in Large Language Model-assisted Brain MRI Differential Diagnosis.
signals.summary: With increasing reader experience, LLM accuracy with reader-generated input improved, whereas accuracy gains from LLM assistance diminished.

signals.title: Performance of a large language model on the reasoning tasks of a physician.
signals.summary: It is suggested that LLMs have eclipsed most benchmarks of clinical reasoning, motivating the urgent need for prospective trials.

signals.title: A multimodal large language model for materials science
signals.summary: MatterChat is introduced, a versatile structure-aware multimodal LLM that unifies material structural data and textual inputs into a single cohesive model, reducing training costs and enhancing flexibility.

signals.title: Artificial intelligence-assisted quality assessment of mid-trimester ultrasound examinations using large vision-language models
signals.summary: A combined CNN-VLM system enables accurate and interpretable automated quality assessment of fetal ultrasound examinations and enhances reader performance in detecting incomplete or poor-quality scans.

signals.title: Align Generative Artificial Intelligence with Human Preferences: A Novel Large Language Model Fine-Tuning Method for Online Review Management
signals.summary: A new fine-tuning method that helps large language models generate review replies that better match human preferences in real business settings and points to a practical path for using AI to help firms respond faster and more consistently to customers.

signals.title: From Large Language Model Predicates to Logic Tensor Networks: Neurosymbolic Offer Validation in Regulated Procurement
signals.summary: This work presents a neurosymbolic approach, i.e. combine symbolic and subsymbolic artificial intelligence, to validating offer documents in regulated public institutions, and employs a language model to extract information and then aggregate it with an LTN to make an auditable decision.

signals.title: Toward Knowledge-Enhanced Geohazard Intelligence: A Review of Knowledge Graphs and Large Language Models
signals.summary: This review synthesizes advances in knowledge representation, knowledge graphs, and LLM-based reasoning, demonstrating how hybrid models that embed physical laws and expert knowledge can improve the interpretability and generalization of machine learning.

signals.title: Using a large language model artificial intelligence agent to improve the efficiency of clinical quality measure evidence evaluation: a case study
signals.summary: This pilot demonstrated the feasibility and potential of LLM-based AI agents to improve the efficiency and transparency of evidence review for CQMs and incorporated additional data sources and extended applicability across the measure development lifecycle.

signals.title: Challenges of using generative artificial intelligence for diabetes patient education: a cross-platform analysis of the quality, readability, and actionability of text generated by large language models
signals.summary: LLM-generated diabetes education texts exhibit marked cross-platform heterogeneity, and exploratory analyses suggest a potential trade-off between readability and both information quality and the completeness of action-oriented instructions.

signals.title: Democratisation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) or Digital Authoritarianism? China's Large Language Model (LLM) Strategy and the Challenge to Western AI Dominance
signals.summary: Using qualitative content analysis of policy documents, technical reports, and international agreements, the study reveals a persistent tension between China's rhetoric of “AI democratization” and concerns regarding digital authoritarianism.

signals.title: Exploring Academics' Orientation Towards Large Language Model Adoption: A Knowledge Management Approach Using ChatGPT and Retrieval‐Augmented Generation
signals.summary: One of the earliest attempts to develop a generative AI application designed specifically for HEIs to enhance KM processes is developed, addressing the limited integration between KM and LLM technologies and the scarcity of studies examining the adoption and usage of generative AI systems among academics.

signals.title: Audio-Thinker: Guiding Large Audio Language Model When and How to Think via Reinforcement Learning
signals.summary: This work proposes Audio-Thinker, a reinforcement learning framework designed to enhance the reasoning capabilities of LALMs through improved adaptability, consistency, and effectiveness, and incorporates an external reward model to evaluate the overall consistency and quality of the reasoning process.

signals.title: PurMM: Attention-Guided Test-Time Backdoor Purification in Multimodal Large Language Models
signals.summary: PurMM is proposed, a test-time backdoor purification framework that removes visual tokens exhibiting anomalous attention, thereby avoiding targeted outputs while restoring correct answers in MLLMs, offering a new perspective for safeguarding MLLMs.

signals.title: AbAffinity: A Large Language Model for Predicting Antibody Binding Affinity against SARS-CoV-2
signals.summary: Ab-Affinity is introduced, a new large language model that can accurately predict the binding affinity of antibodies against a target peptide, e.g., the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein.

signals.title: Quality assessment of large language model–generated prior authorization letters in nephrology
signals.summary: ChatGPT-5 can generate clinically coherent PA drafts for nephrology medications, but limitations in coding precision and citation reliability persist.

signals.title: Readability of Patient Information Leaflets Improved by Large Language Model Artificial Intelligence
signals.summary: LLMs may be employed to facilitate improving readability, but may not be able to reach the instructed reading level at first iteration, and are more useful in simplifying PILs at an initial college reading level.

signals.title: Beyond artificial intelligence psychosis: a functional typology of large language model-associated psychotic phenomena.
signals.summary: A functional typology of LLM-associated psychotic phenomena is proposed, based on the system's role: catalyst, amplifier, coauthor, coauthor, or object, which allows clinicians to identify concerning LLM usage patterns and technology companies to develop specific safeguards, moving beyond sensationalised terminology towards mechanism-specific interventions.

signals.title: Artificial intelligence-associated delusions and large language models: risks, mechanisms of delusion co-creation, and safeguarding strategies.
signals.summary: A framework of AI-informed care, involving personalised instruction protocols, reflective check-ins, digital advance statements, and escalation safeguards to support epistemic security in vulnerable users is proposed, which reframe the AI agent as an epistemic ally, which functions as a partner in relapse prevention and cognitive containment.

signals.title: New Opportunities For the Integration of Artificial Intelligence With Materials Science: From Large Language Models to Embodied Large Models
signals.summary: This review specifically maps the developmental pathways of autonomous experimental platforms, underscoring the comparative advantages of large‐model‐based systems over traditional machine learning approaches and discusses the potential of embodied large models in materials science.

signals.title: AI at the Sella Turcica: Multi-Model Large Language Model Evaluation in Pituitary Adenomas
signals.summary: While LLMs may serve as supportive adjuncts in multidisciplinary pituitary care, structured evaluation and expert oversight remain essential before clinical integration.

signals.title: A multiagent large language model-based system to simulate the liver transplant selection committee: a retrospective cohort study.
signals.summary: This retrospective, hybrid cohort study retrospectively analysed adult patients who received liver transplants from Jan 1, 2004 to June 1, 2024 and generated a hypothetical cohort of patients with standard absolute contraindications to liver transplantation from a random subset of the cohort.

signals.title: Ensuring Reliability of Curated Electronic Health Record–Derived Data: The Validation of Accuracy for Large Language Model–/Machine Learning–Extracted Information and Data (VALID) Framework
signals.summary: By providing a rigorous and transparent method for assessing LLM-extracted RWD, this framework advances industry standards and supports the trustworthy use of AI-powered evidence generation in oncology research and practice.

signals.title: CPGPrompt: translating clinical guidelines into large language model-executable decision support
signals.summary: CPGPrompt demonstrates generalizability across diverse clinical domains while maintaining high sensitivity for referral decisions, and its transparent, auditable framework enables the systematic identification of failure modes and provides advantages over black-box AI approaches.

signals.title: Artificial Intelligence Propaganda Factories with Language Models

signals.title: Large language model use in oral and maxillofacial surgery training: a national resident survey
signals.summary: Findings may guide curriculum development, fostering responsible and effective use of LLMs in surgical training and practice, and guide curriculum development among OMFS residents in the United States.

signals.title: A Privacy by Design Framework for Large Language Model-Based Applications for Children
signals.summary: A framework based on Privacy-by-Design (PbD), which guides designers and developers to take on a proactive and risk-averse approach to technology design, is proposed to support the development of AI applications for children that provide privacy protections and comply with legal requirements.

signals.title: A systematic mapping review on how generative artificial intelligence impacts social and emotional learning: A case of large language model chatbots
signals.summary: This review provides the first structured framework linking 19 LLM affordances to 15 SEL competencies and proposes an SEL development framework for higher education students using LLM chatbots, which reveals a significant imbalance in development focus and a widespread lack of essential ethical safeguards.

signals.title: Benchmarking large language model-based agent systems for clinical decision tasks
signals.summary: It is revealed that current agentic designs offer modest performance benefits at significant computational and workflow cost, underscoring the need for more accurate, efficient, and clinically viable agent systems.

signals.title: The information challenge in public health crises: a study on the reliability and readability of information provided by large language model for thunderstorm asthma
signals.summary: While LLM demonstrate some reliability in handling complex health consultations, none meet the recommended readability benchmark for a sixth-grade reading level, and research findings indicate statistically significant differences in the reliability of various artificial intelligence programmes when responding to complex interdisciplinary information queries.

signals.title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN LANGUAGE LEARNING: A CASE STUDY OF CHATGPT
signals.summary: The research analyzes ChatGPT-generated responses to EFL-oriented tasks targeting writing, grammar explanation, vocabulary development, and conversational interaction and concludes that ChatGPT should be viewed as a complementary educational tool rather than a replacement for teachers.

signals.title: Phase transitions in large language model compression
signals.summary: Structural, numerical, and algebraic redundancy across pruning, quantization, and low-rank decomposition techniques are analyzed, enabling a criticality-aware compression framework that achieves near-lossless compression to 10% of the original size.

signals.title: A Multi-Agent Large Language Model Framework for Marketing Decision-Making with Auditable Attribution Analysis
signals.summary: A multi-agent large-scale model framework for marketing decision-making is proposed, constructing an end-to-end analysis loop around problem parsing, definition alignment, and auditable output, and excelling in constraint satisfaction, verifiable output, and auditable coverage.

signals.title: Fine-tuning a multimodal large language model for clinician-grade autism behavioral scoring from short home videos

signals.title: Empowering digital health management with on-device large language models for glucose prediction: a model development and validation study

signals.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence and Large Language Models in Clinical Oncology

signals.title: Comparison of Large Language Model‐Based Systems and Prompt Engineering for Internal Medicine Clinical Pharmacy Cases
signals.summary: Methods of improving LLM response quality are poorly evaluated in the context of clinical pharmacy practice and need to be evaluated in the context of clinical pharmacy practice.

signals.title: Large language model applications in facial plastic and reconstructive surgery: a systematic review of applications, performance, and ethical considerations.
signals.summary: LLMs report promising application results in plastic and reconstructive surgery, particularly for educational and administrative purposes, but the use of LLMs in plastic and reconstructive surgical practice remains limited by the lack of evidence-based longitudinal investigations and unclear data protection and ethical frameworks.

signals.title: Large Language Model-Assisted Framework for BSM Model Building
signals.summary: An open-source symbolic framework for beyond the Standard Model (BSM) model building that combines a deterministic physics backend with an LLM chat interface, making interactive BSM model construction substantially more convenient.

signals.summary: A systematic scoping review of AI applications in neurosurgery from March 2021 to March 2026, focusing on three primary hypotheses, shows AI demonstrates strong diagnostic and predictive potential across all three neurosurgical domains.

signals.title: A Hybrid Rule‐Based and Large Language Model Artificial Intelligence System for Electrodiagnostic Reporting: Two‐Center Retrospective Evaluation
signals.summary: A hybrid rule‐based and constrained large language model (LLM) system that drafts EDX reports from structured EDX measurements is evaluated.

signals.title: Diagnostic Performance and Error Patterns of a Large Language Model and Neural Network in Periodontitis Classification: A Comparative Study
signals.summary: In this dataset and classification task, the task-specific neural network demonstrated higher diagnostic performance than the evaluated large language model, but the findings should be interpreted in light of the fundamentally different training paradigms and intended applications of these AI systems.

signals.title: Large Language Model Authorship in Ophthalmic Publications.
signals.summary: It is shown that LLM-generated text is increasingly present in the ophthalmic literature and is rarely disclosed, and there is a significant risk that undisclosed LLM usage will continue to increase and may jeopardize authorship integrity and long-term reliability of published findings.

signals.title: Hierarchical Multi-agent Large Language Model Reasoning for Autonomous Heterogeneous Catalyst Discovery

signals.title: Model Construction and Application Examples for Educational Resource Recommendations Combining Large Models and Knowledge Graphs——Using the Textbook “Introduction to Artificial Intelligence” as an Example
signals.summary: Research indicates that this collaborative framework effectively improves the accuracy, coherence, and interpretability of recommendations, providing a viable solution for textbook-level teaching resource organization and the optimization of personalized learning paths.

signals.title: On-device large language models: a survey of model compression and system optimization
signals.summary: A clear taxonomy of quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, low rank adaptation, and hybrid pipelines is presented, explaining where representative methods belong and how they compose, and a practical bridge from algorithmic compression to resource aligned and reliable on device and edge deployment is proposed.

signals.summary: Experiments demonstrate that LLMHHEA exhibits stable convergence performance and achieves better predictive results compared to traditional metaheuristic-ANN combination methods, and provides a new intelligent paradigm for complex optimization and prediction problems and offers robust technical support for sustainable water resource management.

signals.title: Can Artificial Intelligence Support Patient Education in Scabies? A Comparative Analysis of Large Language Model Responses
signals.summary: AI chatbots provide generally informative but variable-quality responses to scabies-related questions, and should be considered supportive resources rather than substitutes for professional medical advice.

signals.title: Performing Best When Needed Least: Reader Experience Shapes Accuracy Gains in Large Language Model-assisted Brain MRI Differential Diagnosis.

signals.title: Performance of a large language model on the reasoning tasks of a physician.

signals.title: A multimodal large language model for materials science
signals.summary: MatterChat is introduced, a versatile structure-aware multimodal LLM that unifies material structural data and textual inputs into a single cohesive model, reducing training costs and enhancing flexibility.

signals.title: Artificial intelligence-assisted quality assessment of mid-trimester ultrasound examinations using large vision-language models
signals.summary: A combined CNN-VLM system enables accurate and interpretable automated quality assessment of fetal ultrasound examinations and enhances reader performance in detecting incomplete or poor-quality scans.

signals.title: Align Generative Artificial Intelligence with Human Preferences: A Novel Large Language Model Fine-Tuning Method for Online Review Management
signals.summary: A new fine-tuning method that helps large language models generate review replies that better match human preferences in real business settings and points to a practical path for using AI to help firms respond faster and more consistently to customers.

signals.title: From Large Language Model Predicates to Logic Tensor Networks: Neurosymbolic Offer Validation in Regulated Procurement
signals.summary: This work presents a neurosymbolic approach, i.e. combine symbolic and subsymbolic artificial intelligence, to validating offer documents in regulated public institutions, and employs a language model to extract information and then aggregate it with an LTN to make an auditable decision.

signals.title: Toward Knowledge-Enhanced Geohazard Intelligence: A Review of Knowledge Graphs and Large Language Models
signals.summary: This review synthesizes advances in knowledge representation, knowledge graphs, and LLM-based reasoning, demonstrating how hybrid models that embed physical laws and expert knowledge can improve the interpretability and generalization of machine learning.

signals.title: Using a large language model artificial intelligence agent to improve the efficiency of clinical quality measure evidence evaluation: a case study
signals.summary: This pilot demonstrated the feasibility and potential of LLM-based AI agents to improve the efficiency and transparency of evidence review for CQMs and incorporated additional data sources and extended applicability across the measure development lifecycle.

signals.title: Challenges of using generative artificial intelligence for diabetes patient education: a cross-platform analysis of the quality, readability, and actionability of text generated by large language models
signals.summary: LLM-generated diabetes education texts exhibit marked cross-platform heterogeneity, and exploratory analyses suggest a potential trade-off between readability and both information quality and the completeness of action-oriented instructions.

signals.title: Democratisation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) or Digital Authoritarianism? China's Large Language Model (LLM) Strategy and the Challenge to Western AI Dominance
signals.summary: Using qualitative content analysis of policy documents, technical reports, and international agreements, the study reveals a persistent tension between China's rhetoric of “AI democratization” and concerns regarding digital authoritarianism.

signals.title: Exploring Academics' Orientation Towards Large Language Model Adoption: A Knowledge Management Approach Using ChatGPT and Retrieval‐Augmented Generation
signals.summary: One of the earliest attempts to develop a generative AI application designed specifically for HEIs to enhance KM processes is developed, addressing the limited integration between KM and LLM technologies and the scarcity of studies examining the adoption and usage of generative AI systems among academics.

signals.title: Audio-Thinker: Guiding Large Audio Language Model When and How to Think via Reinforcement Learning
signals.summary: This work proposes Audio-Thinker, a reinforcement learning framework designed to enhance the reasoning capabilities of LALMs through improved adaptability, consistency, and effectiveness, and incorporates an external reward model to evaluate the overall consistency and quality of the reasoning process.

signals.title: PurMM: Attention-Guided Test-Time Backdoor Purification in Multimodal Large Language Models
signals.summary: PurMM is proposed, a test-time backdoor purification framework that removes visual tokens exhibiting anomalous attention, thereby avoiding targeted outputs while restoring correct answers in MLLMs, offering a new perspective for safeguarding MLLMs.

signals.title: AbAffinity: A Large Language Model for Predicting Antibody Binding Affinity against SARS-CoV-2
signals.summary: Ab-Affinity is introduced, a new large language model that can accurately predict the binding affinity of antibodies against a target peptide, e.g., the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein.

signals.title: Quality assessment of large language model–generated prior authorization letters in nephrology
signals.summary: ChatGPT-5 can generate clinically coherent PA drafts for nephrology medications, but limitations in coding precision and citation reliability persist.

signals.title: Readability of Patient Information Leaflets Improved by Large Language Model Artificial Intelligence
signals.summary: LLMs may be employed to facilitate improving readability, but may not be able to reach the instructed reading level at first iteration, and are more useful in simplifying PILs at an initial college reading level.

signals.title: Beyond artificial intelligence psychosis: a functional typology of large language model-associated psychotic phenomena.
signals.summary: A functional typology of LLM-associated psychotic phenomena is proposed, based on the system's role: catalyst, amplifier, coauthor, coauthor, or object, which allows clinicians to identify concerning LLM usage patterns and technology companies to develop specific safeguards, moving beyond sensationalised terminology towards mechanism-specific interventions.

signals.title: Artificial intelligence-associated delusions and large language models: risks, mechanisms of delusion co-creation, and safeguarding strategies.
signals.summary: A framework of AI-informed care, involving personalised instruction protocols, reflective check-ins, digital advance statements, and escalation safeguards to support epistemic security in vulnerable users is proposed, which reframe the AI agent as an epistemic ally, which functions as a partner in relapse prevention and cognitive containment.

signals.title: New Opportunities For the Integration of Artificial Intelligence With Materials Science: From Large Language Models to Embodied Large Models
signals.summary: This review specifically maps the developmental pathways of autonomous experimental platforms, underscoring the comparative advantages of large‐model‐based systems over traditional machine learning approaches and discusses the potential of embodied large models in materials science.

signals.title: AI at the Sella Turcica: Multi-Model Large Language Model Evaluation in Pituitary Adenomas
signals.summary: While LLMs may serve as supportive adjuncts in multidisciplinary pituitary care, structured evaluation and expert oversight remain essential before clinical integration.

signals.title: A multiagent large language model-based system to simulate the liver transplant selection committee: a retrospective cohort study.
signals.summary: This retrospective, hybrid cohort study retrospectively analysed adult patients who received liver transplants from Jan 1, 2004 to June 1, 2024 and generated a hypothetical cohort of patients with standard absolute contraindications to liver transplantation from a random subset of the cohort.

signals.title: Ensuring Reliability of Curated Electronic Health Record–Derived Data: The Validation of Accuracy for Large Language Model–/Machine Learning–Extracted Information and Data (VALID) Framework
signals.summary: By providing a rigorous and transparent method for assessing LLM-extracted RWD, this framework advances industry standards and supports the trustworthy use of AI-powered evidence generation in oncology research and practice.

signals.title: CPGPrompt: translating clinical guidelines into large language model-executable decision support
signals.summary: CPGPrompt demonstrates generalizability across diverse clinical domains while maintaining high sensitivity for referral decisions, and its transparent, auditable framework enables the systematic identification of failure modes and provides advantages over black-box AI approaches.

signals.title: Artificial Intelligence Propaganda Factories with Language Models

signals.title: A Privacy by Design Framework for Large Language Model-Based Applications for Children
signals.summary: A framework based on Privacy-by-Design (PbD), which guides designers and developers to take on a proactive and risk-averse approach to technology design, is proposed to support the development of AI applications for children that provide privacy protections and comply with legal requirements.

signals.title: A systematic mapping review on how generative artificial intelligence impacts social and emotional learning: A case of large language model chatbots
signals.summary: This review provides the first structured framework linking 19 LLM affordances to 15 SEL competencies and proposes an SEL development framework for higher education students using LLM chatbots, which reveals a significant imbalance in development focus and a widespread lack of essential ethical safeguards.

signals.title: Benchmarking large language model-based agent systems for clinical decision tasks
signals.summary: It is revealed that current agentic designs offer modest performance benefits at significant computational and workflow cost, underscoring the need for more accurate, efficient, and clinically viable agent systems.

signals.title: The information challenge in public health crises: a study on the reliability and readability of information provided by large language model for thunderstorm asthma
signals.summary: While LLM demonstrate some reliability in handling complex health consultations, none meet the recommended readability benchmark for a sixth-grade reading level, and research findings indicate statistically significant differences in the reliability of various artificial intelligence programmes when responding to complex interdisciplinary information queries.

signals.title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN LANGUAGE LEARNING: A CASE STUDY OF CHATGPT
signals.summary: The research analyzes ChatGPT-generated responses to EFL-oriented tasks targeting writing, grammar explanation, vocabulary development, and conversational interaction and concludes that ChatGPT should be viewed as a complementary educational tool rather than a replacement for teachers.

signals.title: Phase transitions in large language model compression
signals.summary: Structural, numerical, and algebraic redundancy across pruning, quantization, and low-rank decomposition techniques are analyzed, enabling a criticality-aware compression framework that achieves near-lossless compression to 10% of the original size.

signals.title: A Multi-Agent Large Language Model Framework for Marketing Decision-Making with Auditable Attribution Analysis
signals.summary: A multi-agent large-scale model framework for marketing decision-making is proposed, constructing an end-to-end analysis loop around problem parsing, definition alignment, and auditable output, and excelling in constraint satisfaction, verifiable output, and auditable coverage.
